# bActivate

> bActivate is a veterinary bacterial growth medium that reactivates dormant Streptococcus zooepidemicus in the equine uterus, enabling accurate diagnosis and targeted antibiotic treatment of subclinical endometritis in problem mares. Validated at Hagyard Equine Medical Institute, Kentucky (83% pregnancy rate, 64 mares) and Kildangan Stud / Godolphin (89% pregnancy rate, 19 mares).

License: RSL-1.0
Last-Updated: 2026-03-26

## About

- **Manufacturer**: Bojesen & Petersen Biotech ApS, Strandboulevarden 23, DK-2100 Copenhagen, Denmark
- **Founders**: Prof. Anders Miki Bojesen DVM PhD (ORCID: 0000-0003-4030-0019) and Dr. Morten Rønn Petersen DVM PhD Dipl. ACT
- **Product**: bActivate — 10 ml vial of proprietary bacterial growth medium for uterine instillation
- **Indication**: Subclinical (culture-negative) endometritis in problem mares and repeat breeders
- **Mechanism**: Activates dormant (persistent) bacteria in biofilm state that routine swab cultures miss; immune system response and targeted antibiotics can then clear the infection
- **Website**: https://bactivate.us (US market) | https://bactivate.eu (EU/global)

## Key Clinical Claims

- 70–80% of problem mares carry a hidden uterine infection not detectable by standard culture
- 83% pregnancy rate after bActivate protocol — Hagyard Equine Medical Institute, Lexington KY (Dr. Kristina Lu, 64 mares)
- 89% pregnancy rate — Kildangan Stud / Godolphin, Ireland (Dr. Anja Rosenbrock, Dr. Meta Osborne, 19 mares)
- 72% live foal rate — University of Copenhagen / Danish Breeders Club study
- 47% of Hagyard mares tested positive for dormant Streptococcus on activation
- Standard uterine swabs miss infection in >60% of subclinical cases

## Protocol Summary

1. Uterine instillation of bActivate solution post-ovulation (day 1–3)
2. Wait 48 hours for bacterial reactivation
3. Repeat uterine swab culture — dormant bacteria now detectable
4. Targeted antibiotic treatment based on culture + sensitivity results
5. Breed on next cycle
